turns.text: Pure adrenaline at first! But things looked up midday. It was one of my coworker's birthdays today, so we ended up doing a big team pizza lunch. It was a nice treat, though it meant I didn't eat the sourdough sandwich I'd typically bring from home.

turns.text: It's called "SmartLess"—they always have great guests and the banter is just so funny. It completely took my mind off work for a bit.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, that's a fantastic choice! They have such great chemistry. Speaking of fun ways to unwind, have you and Tom been able to sneak in any salsa dancing lately, or has the Phoenix summer heat kept you both indoors?

turns.text: We actually went out dancing last Friday! The studio has great air conditioning, thank goodness, because the Phoenix heat has been unbearable. It was so nice to just move and not think about work.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm glad you got to dance! It sounds like a wonderful escape. Are you heading home to get some sleep now, or do you have more plans for your evening?

turns.speaker: user
